fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-09-01 at about 16:40, it was reported that the complainant reported threatening messages from a loan recovery number regarding Rs. 50,000. The online submission was made by Hemanth Krishnan (9000000185). Ganesh Shankar (9000000155) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The identity of the person involved remains unknown at this stage. The complainant mentioned social media screenshots and digital documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Messages reportedly sent to relatives to pressure repayment.
fields.Keywords: loan app, harassment, screenshot, digital document, afternoon, college road, witness
